breakdown.description: The prompt treats the internal axial force as uniform along the entire bar, even though point loads make the axial force piecewise constant with jumps at the loading points.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly states that the internal axial force N(x) is 'piecewise-constant over each segment AB, BC, and CD,' directly contradicting the flawed instruction to treat the force as uniform along the full length. This aligns with the ground truth approach of computing separate internal forces per segment.

breakdown.description: The prompt reduces the problem to one net-load stress state, which conflicts with the need to resolve different internal forces and displacements segment by segment.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification requires computing separate internal axial forces, stresses, and strains for each of the three segments (AB, BC, CD) individually, and sums the segment contributions to find the total displacement. This correctly replaces the flawed single net-load stress approach with a proper segment-by-segment analysis, matching the ground truth intent.
